name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with one leg extended flat on the ground or bent comfortably for lower-back support.
Lift your other leg toward the ceiling and grasp behind your thigh or calf, or loop a towel around the middle of your foot.
Draw the raised thigh toward your torso until you feel a gentle stretch, keeping the knee comfortably extended.
Hold the stretch steadily with deep breaths on one leg, then lower gently and switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips and lower back settled flat on the floor rather than rolling your pelvis up.
Hold behind your thigh or calf instead of pulling directly behind the knee joint.
